# ESET
> Global cybersecurity company providing endpoint, business, and consumer security products, threat intelligence, and support resources.

ESET offers cybersecurity solutions for home users, businesses, enterprises, and partners, with product information, customer support, research, and regional resources across its website.

## Home Security
- [Protection Plans](https://www.eset.com/ca/home/protection-plans/): Overview of consumer cybersecurity plans for devices, privacy, and identity protection.
- [Home Store](https://www.eset.com/ca/home-store/): Purchase and renew ESET home security products and subscriptions.
- [Customer Zone](https://www.eset.com/ca/forhome/customer-zone-2-1-1/): Access home user resources, downloads, renewals, and account-related help.
- [Existing Customers](https://www.eset.com/ca/existing-customers/): Support hub for renewals, downloads, activation, and product management.
- [For Home](https://www.eset.com/ca/home-store/): Main entry point for consumer products and home security offerings.

## Business Security
- [Business](https://www.eset.com/ca/business/): Overview of cybersecurity solutions for small business, enterprise, and public sector organizations.
- [For Business](https://www.eset.com/ca/business/): Main business landing page for ESET organizational security products.
- [Partner Program](https://www.eset.com/ca/business/partner/): Information for resellers, MSPs, and channel partners working with ESET.
- [PartnerNow](https://www.eset.com/ca/partnernow/): Partner-focused portal and program information for ESET channel relationships.

## Support and Customer Resources
- [Customer Center](https://www.eset.com/ca/existing-customers/): Central support area for current customers needing product and subscription assistance.
- [Customer Zone](https://www.eset.com/ca/forhome/customer-zone-2-1-1/): Home customer support resources including downloads and account guidance.
- [Contact](https://www.eset.com/ca/about/contact/): Regional contact information for sales, support, and general inquiries.

## Company and Corporate Information
- [About ESET](https://www.eset.com/ca/about/): Company background, mission, values, and corporate information.
- [Contact](https://www.eset.com/ca/about/contact/): Reach ESET offices and teams through regional contact channels.

## Blog and Research
- [ESET Blog](https://www.eset.com/blog/en/): Articles on cybersecurity news, privacy, malware, and digital safety topics.
- [Welivesecurity](https://www.welivesecurity.com/): ESET’s security research and threat intelligence publication for broader cybersecurity coverage.

## Regional and Navigation Hubs
- [Canada Contact](https://www.eset.com/ca/about/contact/): Canadian regional contact page for support and business inquiries.
- [Canada Home](https://www.eset.com/ca/home/protection-plans/): Canadian entry point for home cybersecurity plans.
- [Canada Business](https://www.eset.com/ca/business/): Canadian business solutions overview and product access.
- [Canada Shop](https://www.eset.com/ca/home-store/): Canadian storefront for home product purchases and renewals.
